definitions: To make a great effort to do something.
To injure a part of your body by using it too much or by twisting it.
To pour a liquid through a sieve or a cloth to separate the solid parts from the liquid.
To put a lot of pressure on a system, relationship, etc., so that it is almost at breaking point.
examples: He strains to hear the faint music.
She strains her back lifting the heavy box.
The chef strains the stock before making the soup.
The economic crisis strains public services.
